Wed 16 Dec · 15:00–19:0012/16（三）· 15:00–19:00

Be there by 14:30! The boat leaves at 15:00 exactly and will not wait.請於 14:30 前抵達！遊艇 15:00 準時出發，不會等人喔。

Day 3 · The wedding 💍

Fri 18 Dec · ANA ANAN Resort & Villas Pattaya12/18（五）· 芭達雅 ANA ANAN 度假村

  • 16:00Arrival: registration, welcome drinks and live trio music on the beach lawn.報到、迎賓飲品與現場三重奏（海灘草坪）。

Dress code: suitable for all

Gentle tones, light fabrics, elegant silhouettes.柔和色調、輕盈布料、優雅剪裁。

Warmly welcomed: beige, sand, ivory, oat, soft blue and muted earthy tones. Please avoid pure white.歡迎米色、沙色、象牙色、燕麥色、柔和藍與大地色系。請避免純白。
Beach-lawn ceremony, then a rooftop party: wear comfy shoes (heels sink into grass) and breathable fabrics.草坪儀式加頂樓派對：請穿舒適的鞋（高跟鞋會陷進草地）與透氣的衣料。
